title: AIAS University Foundation
purpose: Build a capability-linked learning system that transfers AIAS knowledge without misrepresenting professional authority.
scope: Catalog, modules, lessons, canonical resources, progress, assessments, eligibility, identity verification, internal credentials and tamper verification.

requirements.title: Capability-linked curriculum
requirements.statement: Every course shall link to governed AIAS capability assets and canonical resources.
requirements.rationale: Keep learning synchronized with the real platform.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Structured content
requirements.statement: Courses shall contain versioned modules, lessons and resource kinds.
requirements.rationale: Support tutorials, manuals and guided learning.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Controlled assessment
requirements.statement: Assessment shall require completed content, complete answers and a defined passing threshold.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Verifiable credential
requirements.statement: Eligible identity-verified learners shall receive tamper-evident credentials.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Professional boundary
requirements.statement: Credentials shall state that they are not professional licenses.
requirements.rationale: Prevent unsafe or legally misleading use.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Reproducible delivery
requirements.statement: The university foundation shall include tests, documentation, installer, manifest, checksums and release.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

risks: Generated engineering output requires human review.
